run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: First and only generation, written as direct model output in one pass (no geometry script, no image-generation tool, no post-edit). Generated in a fresh conversation whose first user message was exactly the protocol prompt; the SVG was the direct first response. Repo protocol documents, manifest, schema, validator and prior-entry metadata were read only AFTER generation, before submission; no prior submission's SVG source or rendered artwork was viewed before or during generation. The SVG was authored for WorkBuddy's inline SVG renderer (viewBox 0 0 680 380 per host rules). Before writing it, the host's widget_guidelines module was loaded once - text-only design guidance (color palette, flat-fill/stroke conventions, viewBox sizing, title/desc accessibility); color choices follow that palette, and it generated no geometry, so it is listed in harness.tools. Animation is pure CSS keyframes, no SMIL: each wheel's spoke group rotates 360deg around the hub (0.9s linear, transform-box fill-box, transform-origin center); the crank rotates 360deg around the bottom bracket (1s) with two pedal groups counter-rotating -360deg so pedals stay level; each leg is a bent-path group oscillating about +-20deg around the hip (transform-origin at the group origin 0,0), the two legs in counter-phase via a -0.5s delay; the body bobs twice per crank revolution; chain runs scroll via animated stroke-dashoffset in opposite directions; the dashed road line scrolls left one dash period per loop; three speed lines sweep left with staggered delays. Reduced motion is honored by a single @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that sets animation:none !important on every animated class, keeps the speed lines at opacity 0, and reveals a small Chinese notice text; since no SMIL elements exist, this CSS suppression fully pauses the file. The poster is the same file with the <style> block replaced by two static rules (.sl line{opacity:0}, .off{display:none}); all animation declarations, keyframes and the @media block were removed and no geometry changed, freezing the scene at the drawn pose (wheels unrotated, crank horizontal, legs at rest). Timestamp is minute-accurate. Model identity GLM-5.1 comes from the WorkBuddy system prompt for this conversation (also stated by the user); it is not independently verified by an API round-trip, so model.id is null. Harness version 5.8.3 was read from the on-disk plugin cache path. Known cosmetic limitation: leg pedaling is impressionistic - feet trace arcs around the hips near the crank rather than being mathematically locked to the pedal spindles; the reduced-motion notice text is Chinese only.
